host_stream.stability_rule: The selected ring index and all 2048 bytes must match twice before publication.
host_stream.duplicate_rule: The native selector sequence identifies new generations, so byte-identical blocks are retained after a ring transition.
host_stream.mix: Sum eight signed renderer lanes, shift six guard/fractional bits, saturate to s16, mirror to stereo.

runtime_proof.result: PASS: nonzero output from the untouched stock renderer crossed the passive tap into a host audio stream.

cadence_finding.result: The existing 10 ms trace-only audio interrupt causes UI starvation under the current ColdFire TCG model even without GDB breakpoints.
cadence_finding.decision: Keep the renderer tap passive and keep --mock-audio-service separately opt-in; do not let the host callback synthesize or continuously reassert guest audio interrupts.

next_gate.name: AR172_QEMU_AUDIO_CADENCE_GATE
next_gate.objective: Replace the trace-only 10 ms forced interrupt with completion-aware audio scheduling that advances renderer blocks without starving the firmware UI.

safety: All firmware execution and audio capture remained local. No firmware, extracted MAIN, project data, factory sample names, or proprietary PCM are included.
